Use the maude-v2 shared component styles (.btn, .chip, .input, .seg, .switch …).

edits.why: maude-v2's tokens are scoped to .maude-v2[data-theme]; light is maude-v2's default theme (dark is also available).

notes: maude-v2 has no .callout / .callout--info / .callout--warn, .panel, .tab / .tabbar, .tree-row or .btn--icon. They are used here (Get-latest nudge, Publish-rejected warning, the docked panel, the file tree, icon buttons) and nothing else in the project defines them, so they will render unstyled until they are restyled with maude-v2 parts (.island, .row-item, .icon-btn, .chip) or added to GitPanel.css.
maude-v2 keeps mono for Advanced only; this canvas uses --font-mono for file paths and badges. It still renders, but it goes against the system's direction.
The theme goes from dark to light. Use data-theme="dark" instead if the dark look should stay.
The comments at the top of the canvas and GitPanel.css still name system/maude. The mock file path system/maude/preview/components-cards.tsx in the change list is sample data and stays.
